title: SmartCords
description: Clean and useful coordinate overlay for Minecraft. Shows Nether ↔ Overworld converted coordinates and minimal HUD.
body:
SmartCords

SmartCords is a lightweight and clean coordinate utility mod for Minecraft that makes navigating between dimensions easier.

Instead of opening the cluttered F3 debug screen, SmartCords displays essential coordinate information directly on your screen in a minimal and aesthetic HUD.

✨ Features

Clean coordinate display without opening F3

Automatic Nether ↔ Overworld coordinate conversion

Toggle HUD with a keybind Z (show / hide coordinates instantly) Also You can change it from settings

Lightweight and performance friendly

Minimal HUD design

📌 Why SmartCords?

Navigating between the Nether and Overworld can be confusing because coordinates scale differently (1 block in Nether = 8 blocks in Overworld).

SmartCords solves this by automatically showing converted coordinates so you always know where your portal will lead.

⚙️ Requirements

Fabric Loader

Minecraft 1.21-1.21.1

💡 Use Cases

Nether portal linking

Survival navigation

Quick coordinate access without opening the debug screen
